one_liner: ClickUp has a broad public REST API available on all plans including free, with personal tokens and self-serve OAuth2 apps, plus an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal API tokens (pk_ prefix, never expire) for personal use; OAuth2 authorization-code flow for multi-user apps. OAuth apps are created by a Workspace owner/admin in ClickUp API settings; tokens currently do not expire.
access_notes: API available on all plans including Free Forever; rate limit 100 req/min per token on lower tiers.
blocker_notes: Rate limits only; Whiteboards and Dashboards have no API.

evidence.quote: For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow, allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.
Use a personal API token for individual or testing purposes. Personal tokens begin with `pk_`.
The ClickUp API is available on all ClickUp plans.
If you don’t have an account yet, you can sign up for free and create your first Workspace!
ClickUp offers a documented public REST API at developer.clickup.com with personal tokens or OAuth 2.0 and native HMAC-signed webhooks.
